hints.never: Both sides drive at the same speed. What single number describes the whole robot?
hints.bit: Linear speed is the average of the two sides.

hints.never: Spin in place: one side forward, one back. Which side should be subtracted from which?
hints.bit: Angular speed is (right - left) divided by the track width.

hints.never: A deadband is a constant plus an `if` for each stick. Which of those do you have?
hints.bit: Constant at the top of the class, then an `if` on `forward` and one on `turn`.

hints: `private static final double DEADBAND = 0.1;` then `if (Math.abs(forward) < DEADBAND) { forward = 0.0; }`

hints.never: The robot should drive while it's short of 2 meters and stop otherwise. Which keyword says "otherwise"?
